column1: # One row per check. Unlike the other repositories in this set, Makoto's registry
# already DECLARES most of this: `eats`, `tests`, `applies_at`, `layer` and `may_block`
# are fields on Check, so this file is a projection of load_checks() rather than a
# measurement laid over it. Only the artifact was missing.
# EATS       the context keys the check reads, declared by the check itself and held to
#            what it actually reads by tests/test_check_law_eats.py.
# FIRES_VIA  the edge. Note this is not symmetric with ALLOWED_EDGES: prechecks are
#            selected by keyword rather than by edge, and of the 5 allowed edges only
#            Pre and Stop carry any check. Post, SessionStart and SubagentStop admit
#            checks that nothing declares; a check on an edge the dispatcher cannot
#            deliver would load clean and never fire.
# WITNESS    the law that drives this check through its real entry point with a scenario
#            proven to make it emit. Not a unit test of its predicate -- the same call
# LABEL      machine-checked: every row is read from the live registry, and the witness
#            laws are part of the suite that must pass.
